title: e2e recorder drops every non-JSON response, so 'no JSON body where the schema gives one' cannot fire in e2e
notes: The recorder returns early unless content-type matches /json/. If a route the schema types as JSON answers 200 with text/html (such as an SPA fallback) or an empty body with another content type, jellyfin-web receives it, nothing is recorded, and the gate passes. The differential tier does pass the content type, so only e2e has the hole. Reading evidence only: the filter sits at conform.mjs:14. Closed at the pivot: Tied to a Jellyfin route, a Jellyfin app, jellyfin-web, Quick Connect or Jellyfin's tooling, all removed at the cutover (D-107, D-109, rule 3).
